---
title: "Interactive Dashboard"
format: html
server: shiny
---

```{r}
#| label: Install and Load Libraries
#| message: true
#| warning: true
#| include: false

if(!require("shiny"))
  install.packages("shiny")
  library(shiny)

if(!require("DT"))
  install.packages("DT")
  library(DT)

if(!require("DBI"))
  install.packages("DBI")
  library(DBI)

if(!require("RSQLite"))
  install.packages("RSQLite")
  library(RSQLite)

if(!require("ggplot2"))
  install.packages("ggplot2")
  library(ggplot2)

if(!require("plotly"))
  install.packages("plotly")
  library(plotly)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("dplyr")
  library(dplyr)

if(!require("dplyr"))
  install.packages("bslib")
  library(bslib)

conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "virtual_production.db")
dbListTables(conn)

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(
    version = 5,
    bootswatch = "flatly", 
    base_font = font_google("Roboto"), 
    heading_font = "Montserrat", 
    primary="#007bff"),
  titlePanel("Virtual Production Dashboard"),
  tabsetPanel(
    tabPanel("Data View",
      h3("Explore Database Tables"),
      selectInput(
          "table_select", 
          "Select a Table to View:",
          choices = c("Clients", "Productions", "CrewMembers", "Assets"),
          selected = "Clients"),
      DTOutput("table_output")
      )))

server <- function(input, output, session){
  
  output$table_output <- renderDT({
    req(input$table_select)
    df <- dbReadTable(conn, input$table_select)
    datatable(df, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

renv::status(
  
)
```
